scope: Source review only; make_deployment, systemd launch and GPU/control execution were not invoked
agreements: Dual branch calls the unique preparation_permit builder with resident_id/gpu_index/gpu_uuid/source_manifest; no extra permit fields are appended to dual permits.
Spec-v3, declaration and launch readiness consistently use session_protocol=mp-interleave-v1 and maximum_sessions=2; CLI only uses --max-sessions 2.
owner_entrypoint is the full frozen reference for tools/serve_interleaved_owner_v054.py; the exact same reference and the new manager module are included in sources.
Spec source_manifest is the same policy source reference passed to permit.deployment.source_manifest; checker requires exact equality.
Spec preparation_permit, startup --resident-preparation-permit and checker --authorization refer to the same immutable file.
Checker receives the generated declaration path and fresh root/handoff directory; completion is read from handoff/receipt.json.
Dual admission records interleaving_check_receipt equal to check_receipt; failed control does not register the resident.
Existing physical UUID/free-memory admission and original numerical loader are retained; no arbitrary script entrypoint is permitted.
